marks.gloss_en: והקדישו את קדוש יעקב (Isa 29:23), וסמיך ליה וידעו תועי רוח בינה (29:24) -- understanding is placed after holiness
bina after kedusha: 'they shall sanctify the Holy One of Jacob' (Isa 29:23), and adjacent to it 'those who erred in spirit shall know understanding' (Isa 29:24)
מפני שיבה תקום והדרת פני זקן (Lev 19:32), וסמיך ליה וכי יגור אתכם גר (19:33) -- converts are included with the righteous
once the transgressors cease, the horn of the righteous is raised: 'all the horns of the wicked I will cut off; the horns of the righteous shall be lifted' (Ps 75:11)
ורבי נמי, הא כתיב שמע? -- for Rebbi too 'shema' is written, which the Rabbis read as 'any language you hear'
ההוא מיבעי ליה: השמע לאזניך מה שאתה מוציא מפיך (= p_shema_hashma)
'shema' is needed [by Rebbi] for: make audible to your ears what you utter with your mouth
ורבנן נמי, הכתיב והיו? -- for the Rabbis too 'vehayu' is written, which Rebbi reads as 'as they are'
ההוא מיבעי ליה שלא יקרא למפרע (= p_vehayu_lemafrea)
'vehayu' is needed [by the Rabbis] for: that one not read out of order
אי הכי -- לימא רפואה בתרה דתשובה? (ושב ורפא לו)
לא סלקא דעתך, דכתיב וישוב אל ה' וירחמהו... כי ירבה לסלוח -- forgiveness follows repentance (= p_selicha_achar_teshuva)
selicha after teshuva: 'let him return to the Lord and He will have mercy on him, and to our God, for He will abundantly forgive' (Isa 55:7)
ומאי חזית דסמכת אהא? סמוך אהא! -- what did you see to rely on this [verse]? rely on that one! (Steinsaltz: on ושב ורפא לו)
כתב קרא אחרינא: הסולח לכל עוניכי הרופא לכל תחלואיכי הגואל משחת חייכי (= p_geula_refua_achar_selicha)
למימרא דגאולה ורפואה בתר סליחה היא? והכתיב ושב ורפא לו!
ההוא לאו רפואה דתחלואים היא, אלא רפואה דסליחה היא -- that healing is the healing of forgiveness
another verse is written: 'who forgives all your iniquities, who heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from the pit' (Ps 103:3-4) -- redemption and healing come after forgiveness
והאמר מר: בששית קולות, בשביעית מלחמות, במוצאי שביעית בן דוד בא -- the redemption comes after the seventh, not in it (kind svara under protest: no kind for והאמר)
מלחמה נמי אתחלתא דגאולה היא -- war too is the beginning of redemption
Rava: since they are destined to be redeemed in the seventh, therefore they fixed it seventh
Rebbi's reason: the verse says 'and [these words] shall be' (Deut 6:6)
(entertained) Rebbi holds the whole Torah may be said in any language -- else why write 'vehayu'?
(entertained) the Rabbis hold the whole Torah must be said in the holy tongue -- else why write 'shema'?
Shimon HaPakuli arranged the eighteen blessings in order before Rabban Gamliel in Yavne
from where that one says [the blessing of] the Patriarchs? 'ascribe to the Lord, sons of the mighty' (Ps 29:1)
R' Acha: since circumcision, which needs healing, was given on the eighth, therefore they fixed healing eighth
R' Alexandri: the blessing of the years is ninth -- [it is said] against those who raise prices
ingathering of exiles after the years: 'and you, mountains of Israel, give your branches and bear your fruit for My people Israel, for they are soon to come' (Ezek 36:8)
once judgment is done on the wicked, the transgressors cease: 'and the destruction of transgressors and sinners together' (Isa 1:28)
where is their horn raised? in Jerusalem: 'ask for the peace of Jerusalem; those who love you shall prosper' (Ps 122:6)
once Jerusalem is built, David comes: 'afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the Lord their God and David their king' (Hos 3:5)
